title: Russian Drone Strike Hits Train Near Polish Border
subtitle: High-profile Western figures were in the area just before the attack, raising concerns about safety near the EU border.

summary.en: A Russian drone strike hit a passenger train engine near the Ukraine-Poland border on Sunday. The attack occurred shortly after a train carrying former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson and other Western officials passed through the same station. No injuries were reported as passengers had been evacuated following warnings. Polish and Ukrainian leaders described the incident as a dangerous escalation of the war. Officials are now calling for more air defense support to protect civilian infrastructure.
summary.zh: 週日，俄羅斯的一架無人機襲擊了烏克蘭與波蘭邊境附近的一列客運火車頭。攻擊發生在載有前英國首相強生及其他西方官員的列車通過該站後不久。由於乘客在接獲警告後已疏散，目前沒有傳出傷亡報告。波蘭與烏克蘭領導人將此事件描述為戰爭危險升級的跡象。官員們目前正呼籲提供更多防空支援，以保護平民基礎設施。

paragraphs.en: A Russian drone strike hit a passenger train at the Yahodyn railway station in western Ukraine on Sunday, causing significant concern among international leaders. The attack targeted a train engine just two kilometers from the Polish border. According to reports from the BBC, The Guardian, and Deutsche Welle, the strike occurred shortly after a train carrying former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson and several European security advisers had passed through the station. Another train, which was at the station during the attack, reportedly carried former CIA Director David Petraeus.
paragraphs.zh: 週日，俄羅斯的一架無人機襲擊了烏克蘭西部亞霍丁（Yahodyn）火車站的一列客運列車，引發國際領導人的高度關注。此次攻擊的目標是距離波蘭邊境僅兩公里的火車頭。根據英國廣播公司（BBC）、《衛報》（The Guardian）與德國之聲（Deutsche Welle）的報導，這起襲擊發生在載有前英國首相強生（Boris Johnson）及多位歐洲安全顧問的列車通過該站後不久。據悉，當時停靠在車站的另一列火車上，載有前美國中央情報局（CIA）局長裴卓斯（David Petraeus）。

paragraphs.en: Ukrainian railway operator Ukrzaliznytsia stated that the train had left the station earlier than planned due to the constant threat of Russian strikes. The company noted that it is possible the diplomatic train carrying the high-profile visitors was the intended target. Fortunately, no casualties were reported. The railway staff had given an evacuation order about 15 minutes before the drone hit, allowing all passengers to move to safety. Former Swedish Prime Minister Carl Bildt, who was also traveling in the area, confirmed that passengers on his train were ordered to prepare for evacuation before being told it was safe to continue their journey toward the Polish border.
paragraphs.zh: 烏克蘭鐵路營運商烏克蘭鐵路公司（Ukrzaliznytsia）表示，由於俄羅斯持續發動攻擊的威脅，該列車已提前離開車站。該公司指出，載有這些重量級訪客的外交列車很可能就是攻擊目標。幸運的是，目前沒有傳出傷亡報告。鐵路工作人員在無人機擊中前約十五分鐘發布了疏散命令，讓所有乘客得以轉移至安全地帶。當時也在該地區旅行的前瑞典首相畢爾德（Carl Bildt）證實，他所搭乘的列車乘客在被告知可以安全繼續前往波蘭邊境的旅程前，也接獲了準備疏散的指令。

paragraphs.en: This incident is part of a much larger wave of attacks across Ukraine. The Guardian reports that more than 450 Russian drones and missiles were launched overnight, resulting in at least six deaths and dozens of injuries across the country. While western Ukraine is usually considered safer than the eastern frontline, this strike demonstrates that no part of the country is immune to the conflict. In addition to the train, authorities reported that a truck near the border crossing was also hit by Russian fire.
paragraphs.zh: 這起事件是烏克蘭境內更大規模攻擊浪潮的一部分。《衛報》報導指出，俄羅斯在徹夜之間發射了超過四百五十架無人機與飛彈，造成全國至少六人死亡、數十人受傷。雖然烏克蘭西部通常被認為比東部前線更安全，但這次襲擊顯示該國境內沒有任何地方能免於衝突影響。除了火車之外，當局也通報邊境檢查站附近有一輛卡車遭到俄軍砲火擊中。

paragraphs.en: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha described the attack as an act of terror that is "knocking directly on the doors of the EU and Nato." Nato is a military alliance of countries from Europe and North America that agree to protect each other. Sybiha called for more sanctions — official punishments meant to stop a country from breaking international law — against Moscow. He argued that the only way to stop the violence is to make the cost of the war unacceptable for Russia. Boris Johnson also spoke out, calling the strike a "random and senseless attack" on civilian railways and urging Western allies to provide Ukraine with the air defense systems needed to stop such missiles and drones.
paragraphs.zh: 烏克蘭外交部長西比哈（Andrii Sybiha）形容這場攻擊是恐怖行徑，並稱其「直接敲響了歐盟與北約（Nato）的大門」。北約是一個由歐洲與北美國家組成的軍事聯盟，成員國承諾相互保護。西比哈呼籲對莫斯科實施更多制裁，即旨在阻止國家違反國際法的官方懲罰措施。他主張，停止暴力的唯一途徑是讓俄羅斯付出無法承受的戰爭代價。強生也公開發言，稱這是一場針對平民鐵路的「隨機且毫無意義的攻擊」，並敦促西方盟友提供烏克蘭所需的防空系統，以攔截此類飛彈與無人機。

paragraphs.en: In Poland, the situation has caused serious alarm. Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk held an emergency meeting to discuss the incident, warning that the war is getting closer to his country’s border. "The escalation of the actions from the Russian side is becoming a reality, and they are getting closer and closer to our border," Tusk said. He added that Poland cannot rule out the possibility that future Russian strikes could affect its own territory. Polish Foreign Minister Radoslaw Sikorski echoed these concerns, stating that the attack is a major challenge and that nations must double their efforts to support those affected by the aggression.
paragraphs.zh: 在波蘭，局勢引發了嚴重的警報。波蘭總理圖斯克（Donald Tusk）召開緊急會議討論此事，並警告戰爭正日益逼近該國邊境。圖斯克表示：「俄方行動的升級正成為現實，且距離我們的邊境越來越近。」他補充說，波蘭無法排除未來俄羅斯的襲擊可能波及本國領土的可能性。波蘭外交部長席科斯基（Radoslaw Sikorski）也呼應了這些擔憂，表示這場攻擊是一項重大挑戰，各國必須加倍努力支持受侵略影響的人民。

paragraphs.en: For many passengers, the experience was frightening. One British economist traveling on a night train described how passengers were instructed to hide in bushes by a lake while the attack took place. He noted that the Ukrainian railway staff were "grimly focused" and had a clear plan, which helped keep everyone calm. A woman traveling with her eight-year-old son mentioned that they had made this trip many times since 2022, but they had never experienced an evacuation or an attack until now. This suggests that the current situation represents a clear increase in the intensity of the war.
paragraphs.zh: 對許多乘客而言，這次經歷令人恐懼。一名搭乘夜間列車的英國經濟學家描述，乘客在攻擊發生時被指示躲進湖邊的灌木叢中。他指出，烏克蘭鐵路工作人員「神情嚴肅且專注」，並有明確的計畫，這有助於讓大家保持冷靜。一名帶著八歲兒子旅行的婦女提到，自二○二二年以來，他們已經多次往返這條路線，但直到現在才經歷過疏散或攻擊。這顯示目前的局勢代表戰爭強度有明顯的提升。

paragraphs.en: As the conflict continues, the focus remains on how to protect civilian infrastructure and whether Western allies will provide more military aid. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that the locomotive was "deliberately burned," highlighting the intentional nature of the strike. With Russian forces launching more intensive actions, leaders in both Ukraine and Poland are preparing for a difficult period in the coming weeks and months. The incident serves as a stark reminder of how the war in Ukraine continues to threaten the safety of the entire region.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著衝突持續，焦點仍集中在如何保護平民基礎設施，以及西方盟友是否會提供更多軍事援助。烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基（Volodymyr Zelenskyy）表示，該火車頭是「蓄意被燒毀的」，凸顯了襲擊的刻意性質。隨著俄軍發動更密集的行動，烏克蘭與波蘭的領導人正為未來幾週與幾個月的艱難時期做準備。這起事件嚴正提醒世人，烏克蘭的戰爭如何持續威脅著整個地區的安全。

quiz.question: What specific action did the railway staff take that prevented casualties during the drone strike?

options.A: They moved the train to a safer location inside Poland.
options.B: They issued an evacuation order 15 minutes before the strike.
options.C: They hid the passengers inside the train's armored engine.
options.D: They contacted Boris Johnson to request military air defense.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，鐵路工作人員在無人機襲擊前 15 分鐘發布了撤離命令，這使得所有乘客得以移動到安全地帶。選項 A 錯誤，因為火車並未進入波蘭；選項 C 錯誤，因為乘客是被要求躲在湖邊的灌木叢中，而非火車引擎內；選項 D 雖然提到 Boris Johnson，但與防止傷亡的撤離行動無關。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why might the Russian strike on the Yahodyn station be considered particularly provocative?

options.A: Because it caused the most deaths of any attack in the region.
options.B: Because it destroyed a train that was exclusively carrying military weapons.
options.C: Because of its proximity to the border and the presence of high-profile international figures.
options.D: Because the train was carrying the Ukrainian President at the time.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第一段與第二段提到該車站距離波蘭邊境僅兩公里，且有多位國際知名人士（如 Boris Johnson 和 David Petraeus）剛好經過或在車站內，這使得該攻擊具有高度的政治敏感性與挑釁意味。選項 A 錯誤，因為文中提到該次攻擊並無傷亡；選項 B 錯誤，文中未提及該火車載運武器；選項 D 錯誤，文中並未提到總統在車上。

quiz.question: In the sixth paragraph, what does the phrase 'grimly focused' suggest about the railway staff?

options.A: They were angry and wanted to fight the Russian forces.
options.B: They were sad and discouraged by the damage to the train.
options.C: They were serious and determined to carry out their safety duties.
options.D: They were confused and did not know how to handle the emergency.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。在文中，鐵路人員在襲擊發生時展現出「grimly focused」的態度，這結合上下文提到的「有明確計畫」與「保持乘客冷靜」，說明他們是在極度嚴肅且專注的情況下執行安全程序。選項 A 錯誤，文中未提及員工想戰鬥；選項 B 錯誤，他們展現的是專業而非單純的悲傷；選項 D 錯誤，文中明確提到他們有清楚的計畫，並非混亂。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of this article?

options.A: The war in Ukraine is ending because of international sanctions.
options.B: Russian drone strikes are becoming more accurate and less dangerous for civilians.
options.C: The recent attack on a railway station highlights the escalating threat and regional instability caused by the war.
options.D: Boris Johnson and other world leaders have successfully stopped Russian aggression in western Ukraine.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。整篇文章透過這起鐵路攻擊事件，串聯了烏克蘭境內局勢的惡化、波蘭邊境的緊張感以及國際領袖對戰爭升級的擔憂，強調戰爭對區域安全的威脅。選項 A 錯誤，文中並未提到戰爭即將結束；選項 B 錯誤，文章強調的是威脅增加，而非威脅減少；選項 D 錯誤，領袖們的呼籲並未成功阻止攻擊。
